scene.language: Okay. Let me teach you a give-and-go, uh, movement. Uh, so in this case, uh, there's an opponent in front and teammate is on the right side. So you would like to, uh, first of all get possession of the ball. And once... (clicking sound) So [0]get possession of the ball, and once the opponent starts pressuring you, you want to pass the ball to your teammate. [1](clicking sound) And [2]go around the opponent- (clicking sound) to receive the ball from your teammate.[3][4]
